Bearfoot By The Sea

6 Bedrooms 6 Full Bathrooms 2 Half Bathrooms 16 Sleeps Seagrove Beach
  • Description
  • Amenities
  • Reviews
  • Calendar
  • Location

HOME HIGHLIGHTS:
- Gulf views from the rooftop terrace with 360-degree views of Seaside and Seagrove
- Walking distance to the beach
- Private pool & Spa (Heating available for an additional $60 per day during the months of Oct 31-May 1)
- EV Car Charger
- 6 Adult Bikes Included
- 6 seater Golf Cart included

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16):
FIRST FLOOR:
- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin XL over Twin XL Bunk Beds and One Twin over Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only
- Half Bathroom

SECOND FLOOR:
- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower And Soaking Tub
- Half Bathroom

THIRD FLOOR:
- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower And Tub
- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only
- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only
- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only

‘Bearfoot by the Sea’ is a stunning 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom home that accommodates up to 16 guests in the charming Seagrove Beach community, just a short 300-foot stroll from Hickory Beach. This exquisite property boasts breathtaking views and an array of amenities, including a home elevator, a private pool, a rooftop terrace, and a shuffleboard table. Natural light bathes the first floor of this four-story home, where guests can relax in an inviting sitting area while enjoying a game of shuffleboard. The adjacent wet bar, complete with a mini fridge and ice maker, is ideal for crafting cocktails before stepping through the sliding glass doors to the covered patio. Guests can bask in the sun on six loungers by the private pool or savor alfresco meals on the patio equipped with a natural gas grill. Inside, the spacious bunk room features three sets of twin-over-twin beds with private bathroom, and for added convenience, there is a laundry room and half bath. Access the main floor via the home elevator or stairs, where shiplap walls and cypress ceiling accents create a welcoming ambiance in the second-floor great room. Gather with friends and family on the matching sofas and armchairs around the TV before sharing dinner at the eight-seat dining table, which is complemented by a wall of windows that opens up to an inviting outdoor balcony with a bench swing and sectional couch. The gourmet kitchen is fully equipped, featuring a large island that seats five and a side-by-side refrigerator blending seamlessly into the cabinetry. The hall leads to a primary bedroom boasting a full-sized stacked washer and dryer in the closet. The third floor offers four bedrooms, including another primary suite with a full-sized stacked washer and dryer, alongside three guest bedrooms. A wet bar with a mini fridge and Keurig coffee maker adds to the convenience. The multi-level rooftop terrace provides unparalleled experiences, showcasing stunning views of emerald waters, pristine beaches, and breathtaking sunsets. With ample space for entertaining, make the most of the rooftop wet bar during gatherings. ‘Bearfoot by the Sea’ promises a delightful escape that will leave friends and family feeling like they're walking on sunshine, and with on-site parking for three vehicles, it serves as the perfect home base for exploring all that Scenic 30A has to offer. Don't miss the opportunity to make your mark on 30A —secure your next vacation at this idyllic and memorable beach home.

Restaurants Nearby:
- Cafe Thirty-A (Fine Dining, Great Happy Hour)
- Perfect Pig (Casual)
- Dough-Sea-Dough Donuts
- Goatfeather’s Seafood Market
- Prema Organic Cafe
- Surfing Deer (Fine Dining)
- Seagrove Village Market (Casual)
- Pizza by the Sea (Casual)
- Old Florida Fish House (Casual)

Convenient Location:
- Beach Access 150 feet away (directly across from 30A)
- Publix Grocery 1.6 (Bike or Golf Cart)
- Seaside (approximately 0.2 miles away)
- 0.1 mile from county highway 395
- Walmart Market & Pharmacy 11 miles via Hwy 98
